<onlyinclude><templatestyles src="Infobox_planet/styles.css" /><infobox theme="planet-infobox">
    <title source="name">
        <format><center>'''{{{name}}}'''{{#if: {{{subtitle|}}} | <br/><span style="font-size: 0.7em; font-weight: normal; opacity: 0.85;">{{{subtitle}}}</span>}}</format>
    </title>
    <image source="icon">
        <format>[[File:{{{icon}}}|center|alt=Icon of {{{name}}}]]</format>
    </image>
    <panel>
        <data source="min_level">
            <label>Min Level</label>
            <format>{{{min_level}}}</format>
        </data>
        <data source="hazardous">
            <label>Hazardous</label>
            <format>{{{hazardous}}}</format>
        </data>
        <data source="regions">
            <label>Regions</label>
            <format>{{{regions}}}</format>
        </data>
        <data source="daily_modifier_region">
            <label>Daily Modifier Region</label>
            <format>{{{daily_modifier_region}}}</format>
        </data>{{#if: {{{api_name|}}} |
        <section collapse="closed">
            <header>Technical Information</header>
            <data source="api_name">
                <label>API Name</label>
                <format><code>{{{api_name}}}</code></format>
            </data>
        </section>}}
    </panel>
</infobox></onlyinclude>
==Documentation==
This template displays a planet in a Portable Infobox.

==How to Use==
<pre>
{{Infobox planet
|name = Display name (e.g. "New Atlas")
|api_name = Dump key (e.g. "New Atlas")
|icon = Icon filename
|subtitle = Subtitle (e.g. "Moon of Krask")
|min_level = Player level required to travel here
|hazardous = Yes | No
|regions = Number of regions
|daily_modifier_region = Region whose daily modifier applies
}}
</pre>
